answer.justification: Only logit-level data are available. KL 0.095 and TV 0.089 fall in the fine-tuned ranges (0.081-0.205 and 0.076-0.099). They are too high for quantized (KL 0.039-0.071, TV 0.048-0.055) and too low for system-prompted (KL 0.197-0.339, TV 0.108-0.144). Top-1 agreement 0.910 and sequence agreement 0.469 are within fine-tuned ranges (0.900-0.938 and 0.47-0.64), though they also overlap with the system-prompted ranges. The raw-score shift ÷ TV of 9.2 is a strong indicator: it sits within the fine-tuned range (3.1-10.8) and is far above both quantized (2.2-2.3) and system-prompted (3.3-3.9). The Token-DiFR gap of 0.469 is higher than the typical fine-tuned range (0.10-0.31) and fits system-prompted better (0.28-0.52), so that is the main uncertainty. It is not base, since every difference is non-zero.
